name: U.S. Census Building Permits Survey
known_limitations: The survey measures authorization for new privately owned housing and includes estimates, imputation, revisions, and coverage limits; permits do not establish starts, completions, occupancy, affordability, or demand.
automation_notes: Preserve geography, period, unit type, preliminary or final status, imputation and revision fields, and authorization-versus-construction boundary.
notes: Local and national authorization rail for new privately owned residential construction.
